info.title: HMV Global CMS API
info.description: Admin API (`/api/v1/admin/*`, `/api/v1/auth/*`) uses an HttpOnly session cookie set by `POST /auth/login` (`hmv_session`, or `__Host-hmv_session` in production) plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every write. Public API (`/api/v1/public/*`) is read-only and serves published content only. Errors always have the shape `ErrorResponse`; branch on `code`.

csrfToken.description: Send back as the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

reference.description: HMV-YYYY-XXXXXX: the reference the website shows the buyer.

duplicate.description: True when this idempotency key was already received: the existing inquiry is returned, nothing is created.

notificationRetryable.description: Whether the inbox offers "resend": a failed attempt, or one a crash left PENDING or SENDING for 5 minutes.
